Package index

Fixed-sample designs

Rejection region, exact power and sample size of a two-arm trial with a binary endpoint.

BinaryRR()
Rejection Region for Two-Arm Trials with Binary Endpoints
BinaryPower()
Power Calculation for Two-Arm Trials with Binary Endpoints
BinarySampleSize()
Sample Size Calculation for Two-Arm Trials with Binary Endpoints

Blinded sample size re-estimation

Operating characteristics of a re-estimation design, comparison of several designs, and the re-estimation from the data of a trial that is under way.

BinaryPowerBSSR()
Power of a Blinded Sample Size Re-estimation Design for Binary Endpoints
BinaryGridBSSR()
Power and Sample Size of Several Blinded Sample Size Re-estimation Designs
BinaryBSSR()
Sample Size Re-estimation from Observed Blinded Interim Data

Type I error rate

Type I error rate of a re-estimation design, the adjusted significance level that controls it, and its decomposition by the interim outcome.

BinaryTypeIErrorBSSR()
Type I Error Rate of a Blinded Sample Size Re-estimation Design
BinaryAlphaAdjBSSR()
Adjusted Significance Level of a Blinded Sample Size Re-estimation Design
BinaryCondRejectBSSR()
Conditional Rejection Probabilities of a Blinded Sample Size Re-estimation Design
